events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news: we're refunding your $5.00 cancellation fee, paid as a Ryde voucher (not cash). We looked at what happened and the driver cancelled too early. They marked themselves as arrived at your pickup spot and then cancelled after waiting 7 minutes 50 seconds. Our rule is that a driver must wait at least 8 minutes before cancelling as a no-show. Because they cancelled 10 seconds short of that, the fee shouldn't have been charged. Nothing changes on your account — no flag, no penalty. Sorry for the trouble, and thanks for riding with Ryde.

DRIVER: We reviewed your cancellation and found it was premature, so we've refunded the rider's $5.00 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher. You tapped "I'm Here" at the pickup point, but we count waiting time from that moment, and you cancelled after 7 minutes 50 seconds. Our no-show rule requires a full 8 minutes of continuous waiting before cancelling. Those 10 seconds matter, which is why the fee was returned. This is recorded on the case, and no account flag was added. Keep waiting the full 8 minutes before cancelling — repeated early cancellations can lead to an account review.
